purpose: Add temporal bridge observations for shared camera initialization; keep original six evaluation frame hashes per scene unchanged
readiness_rule: All eleven initialization observations registered with >=100 points; additionally verify inclusion of all original six evaluation frames
coordinate_policy: Arbitrary SfM similarity gauge; no measured metric scale or gravity alignment
comparison_factor: Six observations plus five temporal bridge observations at 10/30/50/70/90 percent of the same PTS span; source videos and original target frames unchanged
disallowed_claim: This is a denser initialization input regime, not a result on a changed evaluation denominator or a pure parameter-only gain
